questionGroups.html:
Questions 1–10

Complete the form below.

Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR NUMBERS for each answer.

HOST FAMILY APPLICANT

HOST FAMILY APPLICANT
Example Answer Name: Jenny chan
Present address: Sea View Guest House, Daytime phone number: 2237676 [NB Best time to contact is ] Age: 19 Intended length of stay: Occupations while in UK: student General level of English: Preferred location: in the Special diet: Other requirement: own facilities own television to be Maximum price: £ a week Preferred starting date:

transcript.en: Good morning, how can I help you?
Good morning.
Umm, I understand you help fix up students with host families.
transcript.zh: 我听说你能帮助学生解决住宿问题。

transcript.en: That's right ... are you interested in ...?
Yes.
Well please sit down and I'll just take a few details.
Thank you.
Right now ... what name is it?
Jenny Chan.
Can you spell that please?
Yes ... J-E-N-N-Y C-H-A-N.
Right ... and what is your present address?
transcript.zh: 好的，你现在的住址在哪儿

transcript.en: Sea View Guest House, 14 Hill Road.
OK, and do you know the phone number there?
transcript.zh: 好的，你知道那里的电话号码吗？

transcript.en: Yes ... I have it here, umm ... 2237676, but I'm only there after about 7 p.m..
transcript.zh: 是的，我带了。2237676。但是我只有在晚上7点后在那里。

transcript.en: So when would be the best time to catch you?
transcript.zh: 那么什么时候找你最合适

transcript.en: I suppose between 9 and, let me see, half-past, before I leave for the college.
transcript.zh: 让我想想，我想是9点到9:30之间，在我去学校之前。

transcript.en: Great ... and can I ask you your age?
transcript.zh: 很好，我能问一下你的年龄吗？

transcript.en: I've just had my nineteenth birthday.
And how long would you want to stay with the host family?
transcript.zh: 你想在寄宿家庭住多长时间

transcript.en: I'm planning on staying a year but at the moment I'm definitely here for four months only.
transcript.zh: 我计划是住一年，但是现在我在这里只能住4个月。

transcript.en: I have to get an extension to my permit.
You're working on it?
Fine ... and what will be your occupation while you're in the UK?
transcript.zh: 好的,你在英国期间做什么

transcript.en: Studying English?
And what would you say your level of English is?
Umm. Good, I think I'd like to say 'advanced' but my written work is below the level of my spoken, so I suppose it's intermediate.
transcript.zh: 良好，我想说高级，但是我的写作能力不如我的口语，所以我想是中等吧。

transcript.en: Certainly your spoken English is advanced.
transcript.zh: 你的口语肯定是高级水平

transcript.en: Anyway, which area do you think you would prefer?
Umm, well I'm studying right in the centre but I'd really like to live in the north-west.
transcript.zh: 我在市中心学习，但是我想住在西北地区。

transcript.en: That shouldn't be a great problem ... we usually have lots of families up there.
transcript.zh: 没什么问题，我们通常在那边有很多家庭。

transcript.en: And do you have any particular requirements for diet?
transcript.zh: 你对饮食有什么特殊要求吗

transcript.en: Well, I'm nearly a vegetarian ... not quite.
transcript.zh: 我几乎是一名素食主义者，但不完全是。

transcript.en: Shall I say you are?
It's probably easier that way.
That would be best.
Anything about your actual room?
I would prefer my own facilities - 'en suite', is that right?
transcript.zh: 我喜欢有自己的一套设施—套房，这么说对吗？

transcript.en: And also if it's possible a TV and I'd also like the house to have a real garden rather than just a yard, somewhere I could sit and be peaceful.
transcript.zh: 另外，我希望有电视，我还喜欢有真正花园的房子而不是有院子，是可以让我坐享宁静的花园。

transcript.en: Is that all?
Well ... I'm really serious about improving my English so I'd prefer to be the only guest if that's possible?
transcript.zh: 我很想提高我的英语水平，所以如果有可能的话，我希望我是里面唯一的住客，

transcript.en: No other guests ...
Yes, you get more practice that way.
Anyway, obviously all this is partly dependent on how much you're willing to pay.
transcript.zh: 总之，很显然，这些有一部分取决于你能付多少钱。

transcript.en: What did you have in mind?
I was thinking in terms of about￡60 - ￡80 a week, but I'd go up to a hundred if it was something special.
transcript.zh: 我在想一周付60到80英镑，但是如果房子很特别，我会出到100英镑。

transcript.en: Well I don't think we'd have any problems finding something for you.
transcript.zh: 我觉得为你找到住宿不成问题

transcript.en: Oh, good.
And when would you want it for?
I'd like to move in approximately two weeks.
transcript.zh: 我想大约在两周左右住进去

transcript.en: Let me see, it's the 10th today ...
so if we go for the Monday, it's the 23rd March.
Yes.
Right ... good, and if I could ask one last question ...
transcript.zh: 好的，我想问你最后一个问题……
